title: Install the Smartsheet MCP server
snippet:
# Install the Smartsheet MCP server
You can connect various AI assistants to the Smartsheet Model Context Protocol (MCP) server. Connected to the Smartsheet MCP server, you can interact with your Smartsheet data using natural language.
**Required plan:** Business, Enterprise, or Advanced Work Management

## Prerequisites
Here's what a Smartsheet MCP server connection requires:
- Network access to a Smartsheet production server environment
- Valid Smartsheet API token, unless you're connecting an AI tool that supports Smartsheet's OAuth, such as ChatGPT (web or mobile), Claude AI, Claude Desktop, Gemini Enterprise Plus, or Microsoft 365 Copilot.
To create an API token, refer to the [Get started](/api/smartsheet/guides/getting-started#generate-an-api-access-token) article.
- URL for the MCP server production environment in your target region. Refer to the table below.
**Region URLs**
| **Region** | **Environment** | **MCP server URL** |
|---|---|---|
| United States | US production | `https://mcp.smartsheet.com` |
| Europe | EU production | `https://mcp.smartsheet.eu` |
| Australia | AU production | `https://mcp.smartsheet.au` |
## Connect to the MCP server
Here are links to various AI assistant setup instructions.
| **AI Assistant** | **Instructions** |
|---|---|
| Amazon Quick | [Instructions](/ai-mcp/smartsheet/install-the-smartsheet-mcp-server/connect-amazon-quick) |
| ChatGPT and ChatGPT mobile app | [Instructions](/ai-mcp/smartsheet/install-the-smartsheet-mcp-server/connect-chatgpt) |
| Claude and Claude Desktop | [Instructions](/ai-mcp/smartsheet/install-the-smartsheet-mcp-server/connect-claude) |
| Claude Code | [Instructions](/ai-mcp/smartsheet/install-the-smartsheet-mcp-server/connect-claude-code) |
| Codex | [Instructions](/ai-mcp/smartsheet/install-the-smartsheet-mcp-server/connect-codex) |
| Cursor | [Instructions](/ai-mcp/smartsheet/install-the-smartsheet-mcp-server/connect-cursor) |
| Gemini CLI | [Instructions](/ai-mcp/smartsheet/install-the-smartsheet-mcp-server/connect-gemini-cli) |
| Gemini Enterprise Plus | [Instructions](/ai-mcp/smartsheet/install-the-smartsheet-mcp-server/connect-gemini-enterprise-plus) |
| Microsoft 365 Copilot | [Instructions](/ai-mcp/smartsheet/install-the-smartsheet-mcp-server/connect-microsoft-365-copilot) |
If you want to connect a custom, MCP-compliant assistant to the Smartsheet MCP server, refer to [Manually configure the MCP Server](/ai-mcp/smartsheet/install-the-smartsheet-mcp-server/manually-configure-the-mc

title: Quickstart with the MCP server
snippet:
Here you'll connect to Claude Code and use the MCP server as your coding companion to explore sheet structure, understand your data, and prepare for writing API code. (These connection principles work across MCP-compatible AI clients.)
## Step 1: Set an API token environment variable
If you don't already have a Smartsheet API token, generate one following the instructions [here](https://help.smartsheet.com/articles/2482389-generate-API-key).
Then set an environment variable to hold your token value, for referencing in your configuration.
```
export SMARTSHEET_API_TOKEN="token value"
```
The command may vary depending on your operating system and/or shell environment.
## Step 2: Configure your MCP server connection
Use Claude Code's CLI, to configure your connection.
```
claude mcp add --transport http smartsheet-mcp \
https://mcp.smartsheet.com \
-H "Authorization:Bearer ${SMARTSHEET_API_TOKEN}"
```
If you're using a regional server outside of the US, replace the MCP server URL with one for your region:
- For Europe, use `https://mcp.smartsheet.eu`
- For Australia, use `https://mcp.smartsheet.au`
## Step 3: Test your connection
In your agent chat, test your connection.
**Prompt:**
> List the Smartsheet MCP server tools.

Connected to the MCP server, AI is your Smartsheet coding companion.
Also, you can leverage the MCP server in agent development.

Explore the [Smartsheet MCP server tools](/ai-mcp/smartsheet/mcp-server-tools) to learn the latest capabilities and get work done faster.

title: Smartsheet MCP server introduction
snippet:
Interact with your project data in Smartsheet using the Smartsheet MCP server connected to Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI clients. Once connected, you can use natural language to read, analyze, and manage Smartsheet data to complement how you make decisions and get work done.
**Required plan:** Business, Enterprise, or Advanced Work Management
> ## 🚀 What's new!
>
>
>
>
>
> - **MCP Connectors for ChatGPT, Microsoft 365 Copilot, Gemini Enterprise Plus, and Amazon Quick:** Work with your Smartsheet projects in [ChatGPT](https://help.smartsheet.com/articles/2483728-use-smartsheet-in-chatgpt), [Microsoft 365 Copilot](https://help.smartsheet.com/articles/2483717-microsoft-copilot-connector) (plus configuration [video](https://help.smartsheet.com/articles/2483726-configure-smartsheet-connector-in-microsoft-copilot)), [Gemini Enterprise Plus](https://help.smartsheet.com/articles/2483725-connect-smartsheet-gemini), and [Amazon Quick](https://help.smartsheet.com/articles/2483732-access-smartsheet-amazon-quick).

Our [Quickstart](https://developers.smartsheet.com/ai-mcp/smartsheet/mcp-quickstart) walks you through connecting the Smartsheet MCP server as an interactive companion in Claude Code. (These connection principles work across MCP-compatible AI clients.)
## Why use the MCP server?
The Smartsheet MCP server bridges the gap between Smartsheet and AI models, allowing you to:
- Access Smartsheet data in real time
- Apply AI reasoning with Smartsheet's project and data management features
- Integrate with popular AI platforms including ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Microsoft 365 Copilot, and Gemini Enterprise Plus, or custom AI clients.
- Automate complex tasks that require both data analysis and decision-making
Instead of manually copying data into an AI or writing custom API integrations, you can connect Smartsheet to AI clients to query projects, transform data, and trigger actions.
## How it works
The MCP server exposes Smartsheet capabilities as tools that AI models can invoke. When you integrate Smartsheet with an AI client:
1. The AI client can access (with your consent) predefined tools to summarize sheets, create rows, update data, and more.
2. The client determines which tools are needed to solve your requests.
3. The MCP server executes the request and returns structured data.
4. The AI client processes the results and provides a response.
This enables natural interactions like: *"Show me all overdue tasks from the Marketing sheet and create a summary report"

title: Manually configure the MCP server
Workflow context for AI agents with Smartsheet MCP on AWS | Amazon Web Services
snippet:
[Smartsheet](https://www.smartsheet.com/) has launched a generally available Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server.
With [the Smartsheet MCP Server](https://developers.smartsheet.com/ai-mcp/smartsheet/mcp-server), AI assistants can read, write, and manage Smartsheet data through a standardized protocol. The protocol spans more than 40 tools for exploring, creating, and managing sheets, rows, columns, and automations. You can update task statuses, create rows, and modify project structure directly through natural language.

[AWS Quick](https://aws.amazon.com/quick/) is an agentic AI workspace built for business users, project managers, and operations teams. They can ask questions, update sheets, and build dashboards through natural language without writing code. [Kiro](https://kiro.dev/) is an agentic IDE where developers connect to Smartsheet through MCP to reference project specs, update task status, and track dependencies without leaving their coding workflow.
## Architecture overview
The following diagram shows how the Smartsheet MCP Server sits as the central integration layer connecting to AWS services. AWS Quick and Kiro connect directly as MCP clients.

Smartsheet MCP Server delivers precisely structured context, including row relationships, column types, cell history, and comments. This produces token-efficient payload sizes rather than returning raw API payloads. This engineering decision compounds into reduced cost and improved latency at scale when running hundreds of AI-assisted queries across a project portfolio.

Before connecting the Smartsheet MCP Server to AWS Quick and Kiro, verify that you have the following in place:
- An active AWS account with appropriate AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) permissions for the service you’re connecting (AWS Quick, or Kiro)
- A Smartsheet account on a Business, Enterprise, or AWM plan.
- A Smartsheet Personal Access Token, or OAuth credentials if your client supports the OAuth flow.
- For AWS Quick: Author or higher permissions in your AWS Quick account.
- For Kiro: Kiro IDE installed from [kiro.dev](https://kiro.dev) with `Node.js` available in your environment.
The Smartsheet MCP Server is available at three regional endpoints. It uses Streamable HTTP transport (MCP spec versions 2025-06-18 and 2025-03-26) and is authenticated with either OAuth 2.0 or a Personal Access Token.
- Commercial US: https://mcp.smartsheet.com.
- EU: https://mcp.smartsheet.eu.
- AU: https://mcp.smartsheet.au.

title: Smartsheet MCP server tools
snippet:
The Smartsheet Model Context Protocol (MCP) server provides a way to leverage Smartsheet’s public API via AI clients, allowing you to interact with your data using natural language. The MCP server's underlying **tools** (operations) interact with your Smartsheet data (with your permission) to respond to your prompts. The following sections describe the key tools available to your AI client once [connected](https://developers.smartsheet.com/ai-mcp/smartsheet/install-the-smartsheet-mcp-server) to the Smartsheet MCP server.
**Required plan:** Business, Enterprise, or Advanced Work Management
To execute any tool, your AI client requires specific OAuth access scopes. Each tool lists its Access scopes below its name.
For starters, explore the discovery and navigation tools.
*Tokens* are the basic units that AI language models use to process text. They're chunks of text that can be individual words, parts of words, or even punctuation marks. Both your input and the AI's responses are measured in tokens. This matters because:
- Models have maximum token limits (context windows)
- Processing speed decreases with increasing token count
### search
**Access scopes:** `READ_SHEETS`
The **search** tool is a discovery tool that lets you search across all accessible Smartsheet assets to find resources by name or content.
This tool is particularly useful as a starting point when you need to find an asset ID before using other Smartsheet tools like `browse_workspace`, `browse_folder`, or `get_sheet_summary`.
**Basic Parameters**
- **`query`** (required): The search term to look for. Use specific terms like "Q4 Budget" for better results. You can use double-quotes for exact matches (e.g., `"Q4 Budget 2024"`).
- **`scopes`** (optional): Narrow your search to specific asset types. Available scopes include:
- `sheetNames` — Search in sheet names
- `reportNames` — Search in report names
- `sightNames` — Search in dashboard names
- `folderNames` — Search in folder names
- `workspaceNames` — Search in workspace names
- `cellData` — Search within cell contents
- `comments` — Search in comments
- `attachments` — Search in file attachments
- `summaryFields` — Search in summary fields
- `templateNames` — Search in template names
- **`modified_since`** (optional): Filter results by modification date using ISO 8601 timestamp format to find resources changed after a specific date.

title: Connect Cursor to the Smartsheet MCP server
Set up Smartsheet MCP Server
snippet:
Smartsheet’s MCP server lets agents read and update sheets, search workspaces, manage folders, and create discussions. It uses personal access tokens, so each user should supply their own token through TrueFoundry Auth Overrides.
##
​
Prerequisites
- A TrueFoundry account with permission to add MCP servers.
- A Smartsheet Business or Enterprise plan with API access.
##
​
Register in TrueFoundry
Open **MCP Gateway**, click **Add MCP Server**, select **Connect any Remote MCP Server**, and configure:
| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| **Name** | `smartsheet` |
| **URL** | `https://mcp.smartsheet.com` |
| **Authentication** | `API Key` |
| **Credential mode** | `Individual Credentials` |
| **Header name** | `Authorization` |
| **Header value** | `Bearer {{API_KEY}}` |
Add collaborators and save the server. Users must add their token in the **Auth Overrides** tab before using the server.
##
​
Generate a Smartsheet Token
Each user opens Smartsheet, goes to **Personal Settings** > **API Access**, clicks **Generate new access token**, names it, and copies the token immediately. Paste only the token value into the TrueFoundry auth override.
##
​
Security Notes
Smartsheet personal access tokens inherit the generating user’s full permissions and do not provide granular scopes. Review write tools such as row updates before exposing them broadly, and use [Virtual MCP Server](/docs/ai-gateway/mcp/virtual-mcp-server) to publish only the safest tools.
